role: Research API coverage contract; NOT a shipped conversion database
coverageRule: Documented API existence is NOT proof it succeeds for a particular processing recipe; require in-game recipe-specific probes

entries.data: buildVersion, buildNumber, interfaceVersion
entries.currentAddon: not used by existing profession scanner
entries.caveat: Record build and sample time; client build alone does not reveal hidden server-side hotfix multipliers

entries.data: profession name, parent skillLine, base skill, modifier, skillLineName
entries.caveat: Does not replace child-expansion skill scan; profession slot is not a full specialization inventory

entries.data: selected expansion-specific skillLineID
entries.caveat: Prefer over treating info.professionID or localized names as a verified child ID

entries.data: variant tradeSkillID, skillLineName, parentTradeSkillID
entries.currentAddon: Professions.lua recipe scan lacks exact variant verification
entries.caveat: Preferred recipe-to-expansion identity; verify returned child id with IsRecipeInSkillLine

entries.data: expansion skillLineID, displayName, rank, max, modifier, parentID
entries.caveat: Code currently executes GetChildProfessionInfo first; wiki ProfessionInfo field meanings may be ambiguous—verify live before trust

entries.data: all child ProfessionInfo skill levels when available
entries.caveat: Can enumerate expansion variants; exact numeric skillline identity must be crosschecked by recipe/window API rather than name-only

entries.data: skillLevel, maxSkillLevel, skillModifier
entries.caveat: Requires verified expansion skillLineID, not blindly info.professionID; null is UNKNOWN

entries.data: configID, relevant profession specializations
entries.caveat: Validate exact skillline ID and don't infer points from unknown/unavailable nodes

entries.data: nodeID, currentRank, ranksPurchased, active/committed entries, state
entries.caveat: CurrentRank can reflect preview/granted ranks; inspect committed entry IDs and state; no assumed numeric drop changes

entries.data: perk identities; earned/pending status; descriptions via GetDescriptionForPerk
entries.caveat: Use as eligibility/active-perk evidence; a text description is not a measured drop-rate coefficient

entries.data: learned, craftable, disabled, supportsCraftingStats, isSalvageRecipe, quality IDs
entries.caveat: Learned vs usable vs currently craftable are separate; linked/guild recipe windows cannot establish player unlocks

entries.data: reagentSlotSchematics, quantityRequired, variableQuantities, outputItemID, quality and recipe type
entries.caveat: 12.0 variableQuantities and 12.0 CraftingReagent shape; outputItemID may be absent for random salvage drops

entries.data: skillline membership, environmental requirements, enumerated salvage input candidates
entries.currentAddon: ConversionEngine MinimumProcessingSkill reads only stored requirements
entries.caveat: Neither craftable nor salvage eligible implies known randomized outputs or actual player permissions for every item

entries.data: baseSkill, bonusSkill, baseDifficulty, bonusStats ratingPct, quality thresholds, concentrationCost, ingenuityRefund
entries.caveat: Create actual allocated reagents with 12.0 `reagent={itemID=...}`; no output probability provided; nil is UNKNOWN, not zero

entries.data: recipe reagent rank and crafted item quality
entries.currentAddon: ConversionEngine uses f.quality which can be item rarity
entries.caveat: Reagent quality separate from item rarity and result craftingQuality; preserve item variant ID

entries.data: expected defined output ID and quality variants
entries.currentAddon: No direct read in ConversionEngine model selection
entries.caveat: Does not enumerate every random prospecting/disenchant byproduct or probabilities

entries.data: current available Concentration currency quantity
entries.caveat: Compare to operation concentrationCost only on eligible operations; avoid treating as a yield proc stat

entries.data: actual equipment links in profession slots, item IDs, variants, possible skill/stat lines
entries.currentAddon: Professions.lua does not scan equipped tool/accessory slots
entries.caveat: Profession inventory slots 20–25; API slot-index conventions require testing. Gear link alone does not prove actual operation bonuses

entries.data: item stat lines and tooltip details including enchant-like effects
entries.caveat: Prefer validated GetCraftingOperationInfo.bonusStats for recipe effective values; gear stats may be localized/missing

entries.data: active known buff, stacks, duration, charges
entries.caveat: 12.0 secret/taint restricted; whitelist relevant spellIDs and never assume missing means not active

entries.data: itemID, item link, count, bound, bags/bank when accessible
entries.caveat: Needed for processing pre/post deltas; inventory changes require attribution and batch locking

entries.data: itemID, item rarity, inventory type, expansion, sell, binding; may be uncached
entries.caveat: Keep item rarity distinct from reagent rank; delayed cache must not be silently interpreted as invalid item

entries.data: itemID, quantity, operationID, multicraft, resourcesReturned, quality, concentrationSpent, ingenuityRefund
entries.caveat: Important candidate for real per-cast outcomes; test Prospect, Mill, Disenchant, Salvage individually; some output records may be separate events

entries.data: cast timing, inventory change and loot lines
entries.status: documented general events; usage needs audit
entries.currentAddon: ProcessingTracking.lua logs experiments; inspect exact hook logic
entries.caveat: Need correlate by castGUID/item/recipe with pre/post inventory; never count other simultaneous loot as processing output

entries.data: previously recorded profession, specialization and recipe state + timestamps
entries.caveat: No arbitrary live inspection of offline alts; mark observation age and build, invalidate after patches/gear changes; require eligible alt permission

entries.api: No addon API for hidden output distributions or historical hotfix rates
entries.data: P(drop), conditional yield distribution, current retail patch effect coefficients
entries.caveat: Preserve independent measured per-cast histograms and external evidence, do not infer from crafting quality or average output

normalizationRules: API output probabilities are NOT exposed; API craftingQuality cannot stand in for output occurrence.
A valid call with nil does not mean zero skill/proc or unavailable character.
Each research observation must store API-derived fields with source=live, build, char/session, recipe, reagent allocations, timestamps, and known missing fields.
Equipped item links are evidence of identity; operation.bonusStats is preferred when it exists for a specific eligible recipe.
Offline alts have SavedVariables last-seen snapshots ONLY.
For 12.0 CraftingReagentInfo, check `reagent={itemID=...}` and allocation dataSlotIndex; passing {} can yield missing operation context.
Record actual committed vs preview specialization ranks.
TRADE_SKILL_ITEM_CRAFTED_RESULT event applicability per method must be tested; don't claim DE/milling/prospecting coverage based on event existence.
All numeric transformation formulas require independent gameplay research; client APIs do not expose legacy hotfix coefficient.

recipeScenarios: Midnight prospect R1/R2 each ore, baseline and invested JC
Midnight herb milling with 10 herbs each, modifiers on/off
DF prospecting output quality with legacy stat system active in 12.x
TWW prospect + milling with current gear
Midnight/TWW/DF disenchant green/blue gear including resource event coverage
offline alt with cached profession ranks and aged snapshots
mustCompare: equipped gear and operation bonusStats agreement
